intent: PSI-017: Implement getSession(), requirePermission(), and permission-filtered navigation with unit tests.
summary: Implemented server-side getSession() resolving app_roles, app_groups, and app_permissions from JWT claims, created requirePermission() for page and action authorization, and built visibleNav / useFilteredNavGroups for dynamic sidebar and kbar menu filtering. Verified with 5 unit tests in nav.test.ts, TypeScript typecheck, oxlint, Next.js build, and pgTAP suite.

changes.note: Cached session getter extracting roles, groups, and permissions from JWT claims
Navigation filtering functions based on permissions
Unit tests for visibleNav and visibleNavGroups
Client hook retrieving user permissions and filtering nav groups
Navigation group items configured with permission requirements

decisions.reason: Contract forbids branching on role names; code checks permission keys like 'users.read', 'roles.manage'.

decisions.decision: Run pure navigation unit tests via Bun Test
decisions.reason: Fast, dependency-free testing of pure permission-filtering logic.
